keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Harry Pickering (Blackburn Rovers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Djibril Soumaré (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Hayden Carter (Blackburn Rovers) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Ryan Alebiosu (Blackburn Rovers).
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Gady Beyuku replaces Ryan Alebiosu because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Blackburn Rovers 0, Stoke City 1. Jack McGlynn (Stoke City) from a free kick with a left footed shot to the top left corner.
Substitution, Stoke City. Junior Tchamadeu replaces Luca Bombino.
Second Half begins Blackburn Rovers 0, Stoke City 1.
Substitution, Stoke City. Svante Ingelsson replaces Djibril Soumaré.
Róbert Bozeník (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Moussa Baradji replaces Kristi Montgomery.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Augustus Kargbo replaces Jayden Fevrier.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Yuri Ribeiro replaces Harry Pickering.
Own Goal by Moussa Baradji, Blackburn Rovers. Blackburn Rovers 0, Stoke City 2.
Viktor Johansson (Stoke City) is shown the yellow card.
